title: Mac Cleaner CLI:  a free tool that lets you clean up your Mac directly from the terminal

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Mac Cleaner CLI, a free tool that lets you clean up your Mac directly from the terminal. With just one command, you can scan your system for junk files, caches, logs, and more.
